requiredFindings.title: Materialize member_roots before traversing or forwarding it repeatedly
requiredFindings.finding: The new APIs declare member_roots as Iterable[str], but pass the same iterable repeatedly to classify_path and nested helpers. _custody_state consumes it. A valid single-pass iterator therefore loses admitted member anchors after the first classification. enumerate_units can then admit a member custody directory as a unit, cargo_roots_from_markers can admit a Cargo root inside it, and pruned_anchors_from_directories can omit its observed row. Lists in the checker hide the defect.

reproduction.cargo: cargo_roots_from_markers(['m/Cargo.toml', 'm/.opensip/Cargo.toml'], iter(['m'])) returns {'m', 'm/.opensip'}; with ['m'] it returns {'m'}.
reproduction.enumeration: enumerate_units(['m/Cargo.toml', 'm/.opensip/package.json'], member_roots=iter(['m'])) returns unitDirs ['m', 'm/.opensip'] and prunedTrees []; with member_roots=['m'] it returns unitDirs ['m'] and the m/.opensip custody row.
reproduction.directories: pruned_anchors_from_directories(['m', 'm/.opensip'], [], iter(['m'])) returns {}; with ['m'] it returns {('m/.opensip', 'opensip-custody-state'): None}.

requiredFindings.requiredChange: Snapshot member_roots into a reusable tuple or set at every entry point that traverses or forwards it repeatedly, including cargo_roots_from_markers, enumerate_units and pruned_anchors_from_directories. Add list-versus-iterator equivalence controls for all three, including observed-directory processing after marker classification. Preserve the plan's AST confinement and regenerate the checker report, subject and record pins.

nonBlockingObservations.observation: The control named outermost-target-over-member-anchor uses m/target/x and contains no .opensip anchor. Strengthen it with target/m/.opensip/x, cargo root empty, member root target/m, expecting target. Also add .opensip/.git/x expecting .opensip to support the README claim of both orders against .git. Independent spot checks of both cases passed.
